timeline: Three thousand houses stood in Lima before the 1746 Lima-Callao earthquake; four minutes later, only twenty-five were left standing.
Ground shook for four long minutes.
A twenty-four-meter wall of water raced inland.
A massive wave hurled warships half a mile inland.
Five thousand residents perished in the flood.
